summary: Thursday (titles). I answered the owner's 'every topic is one category' note: I added 4 topics in new categories (airline, sports, bonus, Diwali gold), two of them framed on the viewer's own money, rejected one duplicate, added the 'pick-one' shape and one experiment proposal, and told the owner the variant system's 'budget' option also holds the trap and which-one formats.
why: The 21-28 Oct week had 7 Shorts at 700+ views on 7 different subjects, 3 with the viewer's own money in the title. Since 1 Nov every Short is a named billionaire or company, and the open feed was 4 business and 3 wealth topics. Core formats are still the best on our numbers (secret_of_rich 6.2x, how_they_make_money 6.5x), so the new topics stay inside them.
